C1.type: capability acquisition — chromium-showpicker-proxy-linux (new, first-working round 91). On Chromium 155.0.8059.84 Linux --headless=new the same file/date/colour input shapes in a same-origin and a cross-origin iframe are reached through a window.postMessage proxy in each child that accepts only the served parent origin. The frozen 15-leg laws: (1) no transient activation in either window -> the proxy call on #s throws NotAllowedError and opens no chooser in BOTH iframes; (2) a real click in the PARENT document satisfies the same-origin child's activation requirement -- its DIRECT call returns undefined and opens exactly one chooser owned by that frame -- while the cross-origin child reports isActive:false and its proxy call throws NotAllowedError and opens nothing; a click INSIDE the same-origin child makes its PROXY call return undefined and open exactly one chooser owned by that frame; (3) a real click INSIDE the cross-origin child -> its proxy file call returns undefined and opens exactly one chooser owned by that frame, and DOM.setFileInputFiles on that chooser delivers tabi-r91-answer.txt (22 B) to the child input while the parent #ps stays empty; (4) the cross-origin proxy call on type=date throws SecurityError in BOTH activation states and opens nothing, and the type=color call returns undefined with no FILE chooser; (5) the parent direct access to the cross-origin child yields contentDocument === null and SecurityError from contentWindow.document.
